example_line: org prompt "... Drawer 3 holds the Philippines file. ... Drawer 0 holds the Turkey file. ... Drawer 1 holds the Pakistan file. ... Drawer 8 holds the Iraq file. ... In which drawer is the file on the country whose capital is Ankara?" -> answer org 0; the alt prompt asks about the Philippines (bridge alt), its 4th statement.
